description: Use this when the user wants a gentle seven-night wind-down routine and gives, or can give, a usual bedtime and how many minutes they would like each evening (5, 10, 20 or 30). Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

bedtime.description: The usual bedtime, 24-hour HH:MM, for example 22:00.

language.description: Audio language as a BCP-47 code.

tap.description: The 18+ tap token returned by keep_progress for this conversation; leave empty if there is none.
